prompts: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished 16:9 landscape anime visual novel CG, 2048x1152, no panels, no words, logos or watermark. Narrative: Fuutarou is ill with a mild fever at home; his small daughter Mitsuki worries about him. Reference 1 establishes the daughter's black bob, blue eyes, very small preschool proportions and gentle anime rendering. Reference 2 establishes adult Miku and warm modest Japanese house visual style; reference 3 establishes adult Fuutarou's exact face and black hair. Depict Fuutarou lying in a normal wooden bed, head resting on an ivory pillow, a folded damp white towel visibly across his forehead, eyes tired and half closed, subtle flushed cheeks, blue-grey cotton pajamas and cream blanket up to his chest. Medium wide bedroom composition, bedside water glass and small unlabelled medicine packet administered by adults only. Soft late morning window light, cream plaster and warm wood, peaceful hopeful family scene, expressive clean anime linework and restrained painterly shading, consistent with provided CG. Through the open wooden bedroom doorway at the back, show tiny Mitsuki OUTSIDE the room in the hallway, leaning her shoulder and small hands against the doorframe, watching her father with worried affection. She wears the plain pink long-sleeved buttoned dress from the kitchen reference before adding its apron and headband. Keep her natural black bob, no headband yet. Clear spatial separation of bedroom and corridor, coherent perspective and anatomy. Fuutarou remains the focal point; no Miku in this particular shot. No hospital equipment, no severe illness, no dialogue bubbles. Leave modest safe margins for gentle camera movement.

Frame both faces, hands and apron clearly in medium wide shot, soft golden daylight, cream walls, warm wooden floor and doorway consistent with reference 1; bedroom remains suggested through open door, but no extra people are needed.
